No code change is owed meanwhile.

On the two sheets it costs the same as a Sign and loses money in the worst case, so it needs about 620."* The redo is now **620 display = 3,100 ledger**, with no per-view refund (only a total failure refunds). See #1968 for the Sign side of the same reprice (a flat 1,000, no per-view refund). This PR's 350 must move before it can merge, in addition to the repair already owed.

Relay sweep note (head `bff48f68`) — not mergeable as a bare bump. cookie 2 dropped the `parse` export: `server/_core/sdk.ts:3` (TS2305) and `:114` (TS2345), and at runtime `TypeError: parse is not a function` in session verification — the Google sign-in suite times out on every mint arm. This is the session-cookie reader on the auth surface; porting it to cookie 2's API (`parseCookie`) is a card for a seat with the relay's hand on the diff, not a lockfile merge. Left open.

Relay sweep note (head `1c12bf51`) — not mergeable as a bare bump. The gate is red on a real API break, not a flake: stripe 23 removed `payment_method_types` from `Checkout.SessionCreateParams`, and `server/stripe/stripeService.ts:106` and `:172` still pass it (TS2561, caught by `check:casting-tests` and `server/castingV2/typecheckGate.test.ts`). This is a money surface: porting it means choosing what replaces the explicit card-only list (Stripe's dashboard-managed payment methods, or `payment_method_configuration`), which changes what a customer is offered at checkout. That is a card for a seat with the relay's hand on the diff, not a lockfile merge. Left open.
